description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham is a national motel chain property located in Fort Nelson, BC, a remote community on the Alaska Highway in the Northern Rockies. Fort Nelson sits at a key waypoint for cyclists riding the Alaska Highway corridor — one of the most dramatic and isolated touring routes in North America. As one of the few accommodation options in town, this motel serves as a practical base for long-distance riders covering significant mileage between services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL from OSM resolves to the Wyndham Hotels corporate booking page for the Super 8 Fort Nelson BC property, confirming the business is real and active. However, the extracted website content is almost entirely navigation boilerplate and booking interface elements with no property-specific amenity details, so no cycling-relevant amenities can be confirmed from the website. The single OSM amenity tag (internet_access=wlan) cannot be treated as authoritative per the rules without website corroboration.
concerns: Website content returned only Wyndham corporate navigation boilerplate with no property-specific amenity details; all amenity fields remain unverifiable from website evidence.
Phone number and address could not be corroborated from the website content extracted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel at a critical Alaska Highway waypoint in Fort Nelson. One of the few accommodation options for touring cyclists on this remote corridor and clearly publicly accessible.
enrichment_extras.notes: Fort Nelson is a strategically important stop on the Alaska Highway cycling route. Direct contact with the property is recommended to confirm bike storage arrangements, as no property-level amenity details were available from the website.
